mapper.select: SELECT a.id, a.organizer_id, a.title, a.summary, a.cover_url, a.location, a.start_time, a.end_time, a.registration_deadline, a.registered_count, a.is_featured, a.status, op.organizer_name, ac.name AS category_names, CAST(ac.id AS CHAR) AS category_id_list, COALESCE( MAX(lcm.campus_code), CASE WHEN a.location LIKE '%线上%' THEN 'ONLINE' WHEN TRIM(COALESCE(a.location, '')) != '' THEN 'NORTH' ELSE '' END ) AS location_campus FROM activities a LEFT JOIN organizer_profiles op ON op.user_id = a.organizer_id LEFT JOIN activity_reviews ar ON ar.activity_id = a.id LEFT JOIN activity_categories ac ON ac.id = a.category_id LEFT JOIN location_campus_mapping lcm ON lcm.location_name = a.location AND lcm.enabled = 1 WHERE a.visibility = 'PUBLIC' AND ar.review_status = 'APPROVED' AND a.status IN ('PUBLISHED', 'REGISTRATION_OPEN', 'REGISTRATION_CLOSED', 'ONGOING') AND a.start_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 7 DAY) AND a.start_time <= DATE_ADD(NOW(), INTERVAL 60 DAY) GROUP BY a.id, a.organizer_id, a.title, a.summary, a.cover_url, a.location, a.start_time, a.end_time, a.registration_deadline, a.registered_count, a.is_featured, a.status, op.organizer_name ORDER BY a.start_time ASC

SELECT a.category_id AS category_id, COUNT(*) AS score FROM ( SELECT activity_id FROM activity_registrations WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status IN ('REGISTERED', 'CHECKED_IN') UNION ALL SELECT activity_id FROM activity_favorites WHERE user_id = #{userId} UNION ALL SELECT activity_id FROM activity_comments WHERE user_id = #{userId} ) user_acts INNER JOIN activities a ON a.id = user_acts.activity_id WHERE a.category_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY a.category_id

SELECT organizer_id, COUNT(*) AS score FROM ( SELECT a.organizer_id FROM activity_registrations ar INNER JOIN activities a ON a.id = ar.activity_id WHERE ar.user_id = #{userId} AND ar.status IN ('REGISTERED', 'CHECKED_IN') UNION ALL SELECT a.organizer_id FROM activity_favorites af INNER JOIN activities a ON a.id = af.activity_id WHERE af.user_id = #{userId} UNION ALL SELECT organizer_id FROM organizer_follows WHERE user_id = #{userId} ) user_orgs GROUP BY organizer_id

SELECT a.category_id AS category_id, COUNT(*) AS score FROM student_profiles sp INNER JOIN activity_registrations ar ON ar.user_id = sp.user_id INNER JOIN activities a ON a.id = ar.activity_id WHERE sp.college = #{college} AND sp.user_id != #{excludeUserId} AND ar.status IN ('REGISTERED', 'CHECKED_IN') AND a.category_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY a.category_id ORDER BY score DESC LIMIT 10
